name: Distracting Jarven
summary: Jarven Thunderbrew watches the cellar stores at Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Forbidden to touch the barrels, he asks a passing traveler to bring him a mug of Thunder Ale from upstairs, hoping it will sharpen his wits on duty.

sections.title: A Thirsty Guard on Duty
sections.body: In Kharanos, Jarven Thunderbrew keeps watch over the deep stores of Thunderbrew Distillery. His family forbids him to drink from the stock while on guard, though the finest stout in Dun Morogh surrounds him. The temptation wins out, and he asks passing travelers to fetch a pint of potent Thunder Ale from the taps upstairs.

sections.title: A Dubious Sharpener
sections.body: Jarven says a good drink will hone his senses and strengthen his watch. Whether a guard should drink on duty remains an open question. Few hardy dwarves in Dun Morogh can fault a Thunderbrew for wanting a taste of the brew made by his own kin.

faq.answer: Jarven Thunderbrew belongs to the renowned Thunderbrew family and watches the stored casks in the cellar of Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.

faq.q: Why does Jarven need someone to bring him ale?
faq.answer: Jarven's family forbids him to drink from the cellar stock while he is on watch. He asks an outsider to bring him a fresh mug from upstairs, avoiding the sealed casks.
The innkeeper and bartenders serve Thunder Ale upstairs in the main taproom of Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.

faq.q: Where is the Thunderbrew Distillery located?
faq.answer: In Kharanos, Thunderbrew Distillery is the central inn, in the snowy heart of Dun Morogh just down the mountain from Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is Thunderbrew ale so famous?
faq.answer: The Thunderbrew clan's stout and ales are famous across Khaz Modan and beyond for their strong punch, flavor, and dwarven kick.

faq.q: Does getting Jarven drunk cause any trouble?
faq.answer: Jarven says the ale sharpens his wits instead of dulling them, though it keeps his attention from anyone poking around the lower storage.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the agony of standing guard beside casks of legendary ale without a single swallow.
As a rogue, you know strong liquor can distract a watchman, though Jarven asks for the distraction himself.
